'''Malievo Valaine''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] representative of [[Esstran Exports]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He frequented the Cartel Bazaar on the Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Reputation Vendor for Esstran Exports on the Imperial Fleet, Malievo Valaine was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[May 4]], [[2015]] along with the Core Worlds and Deep Core Explorer Packs&mdash;the first of the Explorer Packs, Cartel Market packs to which the Esstran Exports Reputation corresponds. Unlike other Reputation Vendors, Valaine does not appear in the Cartel Bazaar on both factions' fleets; instead, [[Serrath]] is the Republic faction's vendor.<ref name="TOR" />
